titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Supporters of former Prime Minister Imran Khan march to Pakistan's capital.
France closes up to 500 schools Monday in response to student protests.
The U.S. Air Force removed all bombers from RAF Fairford, a British military base.
Brazil's presidential election heads to a runoff between former President Jair Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people.
